purpose: Teach: 趣向/営み/勤める/試聴/範疇/本位/比重/集英社

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新商品に趣向を凝らせ
lines.en: Our new product line needs to reflect careful craftsmanship and distinctive design.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Direct eye contact. Each phrase weighted equally—no hesitation or softness. The tone of someone setting expectation, not inviting discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の日々の営みを大切にいたします
lines.en: Yes. We'll ensure our staff's daily contributions are valued and recognized.
lines.style: Respectful, formal cadence. Slight nod at the opening. Steady, almost ceremonial—the acknowledgment of someone receiving a directive and taking it seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、勤める社員に誇りを持たせろ
lines.en: Our employees should leave work each day feeling proud of what they do here.
lines.style: Deliberate pause after the opening phrase. Firm conviction on 'pride'—not a request, a mandate. Lower register, resonant. The voice of someone who believes this matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新CD試聴会を計画しております
lines.en: Yes. We're planning a listening event for the new album to build that sense of ownership.
lines.style: Attentive, slightly eager. Forward lean in the voice. Concrete and specific—he's thought this through. Professional but with a quiet note of enthusiasm underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本件は通常範疇外として扱え
lines.en: This initiative falls outside our core business scope. Handle it accordingly.
lines.style: Clipped, matter-of-fact. No elaboration. The tone of drawing a boundary clearly and expecting it to be understood without debate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。顧客本位の経営に徹します
lines.en: Understood. We'll keep our focus on customer-centered operations and stay disciplined about it.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment, then deliberate. Underlining 'customer-centered' and 'disciplined'—showing he's received the correction and will course-correct.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本業の比重を見直せ
lines.en: We need to reassess where our primary business is concentrating its resources.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Slight slowdown on 'reassess'—this is less a directive, more an observation. The tone of someone inviting recalibration rather than declaring it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。集英社系の出版社と提携を進めます
lines.en: Yes. We're pursuing a partnership with Shueisha's publishing division to strengthen our position.
lines.style: Definitive closing. Slight uptick in confidence—this is the answer, the path forward. Professional, conclusive. The tone of someone marking the end of a directive cycle.
